units.source_text: 他所居住的世界是个透明的结构体。

en.t: The world he inhabited was a transparent structure.

units.source_text: 对我来说，这个透明的结构体平时总是个高深莫测的谜。

en.t: To me, this transparent structure had always been an unfathomable mystery in ordinary times.

units.source_text: 由于他的死，这个谜就变得更加可怕了。

en.t: Because of his death, that mystery became still more terrifying.

units.source_text: 从旁边驶出来的卡车，好像撞上了透明的一尘不染的玻璃，把这个透明的世界撞得粉碎了。

en.t: The truck that came out from the side seemed to strike a transparent, spotless pane of glass, smashing this transparent world to pieces.

units.source_text: 马川不是病死，其本身是符合这个比喻的。

en.t: The fact that Magawa did not die of illness was itself in keeping with this metaphor.

units.source_text: 所谓事故死亡这种纯粹的死，的确合乎他的无比纯洁的生的结构。

en.t: This pure death called accidental death truly suited the structure of his incomparably pure life.

units.source_text: 通过瞬间的冲突接触之后，他的生同他的死化合了。

en.t: After the momentary collision and contact, his life combined chemically with his death.
It was a swift chemical reaction...

units.source_text: 毫无疑问，那光明磊落的怪青年，只有通过这种过激的方法才能同自己的影子、自己的死联结在一起。

en.t: Without a doubt, that openhearted and strange young man could be joined to his own shadow, to his own death, only through such an extreme method.
